historic_survey.finding: Significant for industrial associations, not architecture
historic_survey.note: The Klockars Blacksmith Shop of 1911: a Mission Revival building with a simple shaped roof parapet, no other ornament and, unusually for the style, wood cladding rather than stucco. Its significance rests on its association with industry in the city rather than on its architecture.

building.completed_conflict: The assessor's roll gives 1913; the city's statement on Progressive Era and early revival styles gives 1911.
building.name: Klockars Blacksmith and Metal Works

historical_record.description: Klockars Blacksmith and Metal Works was built, and was later designated a city landmark.

unknowns: A 1986 environmental review for 300 Beale Street dates this building 1912 and gives its address as 443 Folsom Street; a 1991 review for 300 Howard Street gives the Edwin Klockars Blacksmith Shop, City Landmark No. 149, as 449 Folsom Street.
